screens.name: Home — home, home-transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows the dominant gold orb and empty omen, while supplied runtime evidence reports enlarged-text, clearance, contrast and reduced-motion checks.
findings: Make the faint example question above the orb consistently legible throughout its appearance.

screens.name: Home — populated omen fixture
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows a populated omen beneath the Home orb with navigation remaining visible.
findings: Give the omen slightly more separation from the raised Ask navigation orb.

screens.name: Approach — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows consistent opening-state composition, and supplied motion evidence reports an immediate reduced-motion approach.
findings: Keep this introductory wait brief so it does not feel like an additional processing stage.

screens.name: Ask — focused question, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 02 and 04 show the question editor and transition, with supplied evidence reporting four-line capacity, exact input scaling and retained text.
findings: Replace the technical phrase 'your prediction engine' with a concise explanation of where submitted text goes.

screens.name: Ask — saved-person composer, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 03, 20 and 21 show Alex retained in the composer, and supplied runtime evidence reports a real request using the saved identity.
findings: Keep a clearer persistent editing affordance on the question after its focus outline disappears.

screens.name: Named-person editor — selected Someone, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 02–04 show explicit person modes, a labeled name field and selected checkmark, with reported validation, cancellation and focus-return checks.
findings: Keep Cancel changes readily discoverable when enlarged text pushes it below the initial viewport.

screens.name: Adaptive card 1 — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 04–05 show the first question and four answer rows, while supplied runtime evidence reports single keyboard advancement and retained answers.
findings: Clarify what 'settled' measures because 'Halfway there' and 'Nearly certain' describe different dimensions.

screens.name: Adaptive card 2 — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows a readable obstacle question with consistent rows and a textual 2-of-3 progress indicator.
findings: Make the selectable nature of the quiet answer rows more immediately apparent.

screens.name: Adaptive card 3 — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 05–06 show the final support question with the same row rhythm and completed progress segments.
findings: Signal that selecting the final answer starts forecast preparation.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty, transition and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 shows the retained question, empty textarea and disabled Continue, with reported enlarged short-viewport and keyboard checks.
findings: Rename 'Choices' to 'Back to choices' to make its navigation role explicit.

screens.name: Planning — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 19 shows stage-specific processing copy, a time expectation and Cancel, with reported timeout, cancellation and motion checks.
findings: Preserve the explicit waiting-time and credit reassurance across every processing stage.

screens.name: Research — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 22–23 show research-specific supporting copy and Cancel, with supplied runtime evidence reporting real forecast completion and recovery.
findings: Reduce the strongest background mist behind supporting text to maintain the planning screen's visual calm.

screens.name: Voice entry — unavailable, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows a microphone failure notice, typing fallback and retry, and current runtime evidence reports successful fallback use.
findings: Place the microphone failure explanation beside the fallback controls instead of at the bottom of a largely empty screen.

screens.name: Planning failure — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 07–08 show Try again, Edit question and no-charge reassurance, with reported injected failure and successful real retry.
findings: Remove the visible rectangular mist boundary above the error-state orb.

screens.name: Prediction failure — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 adds Review answers to retry and editing recovery, while supplied runtime evidence reports preserved answers and credits.
findings: Keep the orb's atmospheric edges continuous with the background in both settled and transition states.

screens.name: Sensitive question — planning redirect
screens.evidence: Sheets 24–25 show support, alternate-question and editing actions with explicit credit and memory reassurance.
findings: Place the explanation before the support button so users understand the redirect before choosing an action.

screens.name: Sensitive question — prediction redirect
screens.evidence: Sheet 25 shows the prediction-stage redirect and corresponding transition, with supplied evidence reporting sensitive-request handling.
findings: Quiet the mist behind the explanation and keep the reason adjacent to its support action.

screens.name: Forecast reveal — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 23–24 show the forecast, qualification, date and sharing hierarchy, with supplied runtime evidence reporting a real dated forecast.
findings: Keep the speculative qualification visually closer to the headline so the large declarative prediction does not overshadow it.

screens.name: Forecast check-in — unanswered, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows Yes, Not quite and Not yet above Share this glimpse.
findings: Give the outcome choices a clearer grouped-control treatment so the check-in task competes less with sharing.

screens.name: Forecast outcome — Not quite saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 shows a checked Not quite choice, inline saved status and confirmation notice, with reported outcome persistence.
findings: Reduce duplicate confirmation once the inline saved status provides a durable acknowledgment.

screens.name: Forecast outcome — Not yet saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 18 shows the selected pending outcome, saved status and 'Still waiting to unfold' notice.
findings: Keep the pending outcome acknowledgment compact so it does not dominate the lower screen.

screens.name: Forecast outcome — Yes saved
screens.evidence: Sheet 18 shows a checked Yes choice and Came true status, with supplied evidence reporting persistence into History.
findings: Use one consistent outcome label between the selected choice and its saved status.

screens.name: Evidence overview — settled, transition and enlarged reader
screens.evidence: Sheets 21 and 23 show four evidence categories, descriptive counts and return navigation, with reported keyboard and full-content checks.
findings: Keep the overview's small section label clear of the fixed header when entering or restoring scroll position.

screens.name: Evidence — Your answers, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 and 19–20 show long answer sections and focused headings, with supplied evidence reporting complete content and keyboard return behavior.
findings: Use the original question as each answer's label to make long records easier to identify.

screens.name: Evidence — Assumptions, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 09 and 20 show assumptions with return navigation and enlarged wrapping, with reported lossless reader content and focus checks.
findings: Separate reading content more clearly from the repeated forecast action group below it.

screens.name: Evidence — Why this forecast, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 09–10 and 21–22 show separated reasoning passages, with supplied evidence reporting entire-text equality and real-forecast reader checks.
findings: Reduce mist contrast behind dense reasoning and label the passage roles to improve scanning.

screens.name: Evidence — Current sources, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 10 and 22 show long gold source titles and muted publication metadata, with supplied contrast and enlarged-reader checks.
findings: Give each source a more compact visual hierarchy so long titles do not overwhelm provenance metadata.

screens.name: Free Why disclosure — settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 24 shows full reasoning and a Plus action but no visibly labeled return-to-forecast action.
findings: Add an explicit Back to forecast action instead of relying on the ambiguous close icon.

screens.name: Share — collapsed options, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 27 shows preview enlargement, PNG download and privacy explanation, with supplied evidence reporting actual export and keyboard return.
findings: Make the preview's qualification easier to inspect before opening the full-size image.

screens.name: Share — expanded Invite & remind
screens.evidence: Sheet 27 shows expanded invitation controls beneath the preview, while the title is partially scrolled behind the fixed header.
findings: Use a cleaner header boundary so partially occluded title lettering does not remain visible during scrolling.

screens.name: Share — export preparing
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows a disabled Preparing image button and duplicate status text, with supplied evidence reporting single encoding after double activation.
findings: Consolidate the repeated preparing message into one clearly announced status.

screens.name: Share — export failure and retry
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows an export failure directly below the enabled download action, with supplied evidence reporting injected failure and successful retry.
findings: Rename the recovery action 'Try download again' while the export error is present.

screens.name: Shared image inspection — story, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 26 and 28 show the full-width composition and transcript entry, with supplied evidence reporting exact accessible text and keyboard entry/return.
findings: Increase the raster qualification's prominence so it remains readable when the exported image is viewed small.

screens.name: History — empty, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows a clear empty-state message, Ask the Ball action and local-storage explanation.
findings: Give the empty-state Ask action a stronger button affordance.

screens.name: History — populated, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows a date rail, original question, forecast and check-back date, with supplied runtime evidence reporting saved history.
findings: Make it visually explicit that tapping a history row reopens the reading.

screens.name: History — stress list
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows multiple long entries extending beneath persistent navigation, and supplied layout evidence reports scrollable content clearance.
findings: Use a more compact row summary to make longer histories easier to scan.

screens.name: History — persisted outcome
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows Came true on the latest row, and supplied runtime evidence reports persisted outcome changes.
findings: Keep the outcome marker in a consistent row position as entries wrap.

screens.name: Sky — offline samples, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 28 explicitly labels offline samples, selected Love and Retry, with supplied timing evidence covering ambient Sky.
findings: Strengthen the stars' control affordance without relying on users interpreting decorative symbols as buttons.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows an offline notice, Retry, disabled creation and a disabled sharing preference with an age explanation.
findings: Distinguish controls disabled by offline status from those disabled by age eligibility.

screens.name: Onboarding — age confirmation, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows explicit age choices, with current runtime evidence reporting fresh, friend and legacy acceptance/decline/reload gates.
findings: Preserve the direct wording and lack of an ordinary bypass action.

screens.name: Onboarding — optional birthday, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows the optional labeled date field, Continue and Skip, with supplied evidence reporting invalid/valid and skipped-onboarding paths.
findings: Avoid presenting two apparently equivalent actions when the optional birthday is empty.

screens.name: Age restriction — onboarding and profile, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 01 and 15 show a distinct restriction page, with current evidence reporting under-13 persistence, no Skip/Continue bypass, focus and contrast checks.
findings: Preserve correction as the single recovery route without implying that eligibility has been independently verified.

screens.name: Onboarding — birthday correction, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 15–16 show explicit correction and return actions, while the enlarged placeholder is visibly truncated and runtime reports retained age validation.

screens.name: Onboarding — focus unselected, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 17 shows four unselected focus rows and Meet the Ball, with supplied evidence reporting single-selection keyboard behavior.

screens.name: Onboarding — focus selected, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 16–17 show Learning & growth selected with color and checkmark, with supplied layout evidence reporting access to the enlarged offscreen continuation.

screens.name: Plans — normal, transition and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 18–19 show selected annual billing, monthly comparison, packs and explicit simulation labels, with reported simulated-purchase checks.
findings: Keep both plans' price, billing interval and selection marker grouped consistently after enlarged-text reflow.

screens.name: You — profile and memory, settled and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 30 shows birth profile, plan balance and remembered focus, with supplied evidence reporting memory editing and Undo.
findings: Give profile, plan and memory sections a clearer spacing rhythm to reduce the accumulation of similar separators.

screens.name: You — optional birth details, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheet 29 shows time and city fields plus disabled lookup/reveal controls, with supplied evidence reporting live geocoding and a calculated chart.
findings: Explain the lookup-then-reveal sequence beside the fields so disabled actions have an obvious cause.

screens.name: You — birthday editor, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 29–30 show focused editing with persistent label/example and Save/Cancel, with current evidence reporting persistence and restored focus.
findings: Preserve this focused editor pattern for other editable profile facts.

screens.name: You — invalid birthday, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows 2020-02-31 and a local error, with current evidence reporting an alert, retained editor and unchanged stored profile.
findings: Explain that the entered calendar date does not exist instead of repeating a format the user already followed.

screens.name: You — settings controls, normal and enlarged
screens.evidence: Sheets 25–26 show preference switches and secondary settings, with supplied evidence reporting keyboard, storage and actual motion stopping.
findings: Avoid partially visible text under the fixed header and bottom navigation when restoring the settings scroll position.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: Home uses a dominant gold orb across sheets 12–13, with supplied evidence reporting browser activation, enlargement and actual motion-preference handling.
findings: Remove rectangular mist seams around supporting orbs while preserving the Home orb's prominence.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Core screens show five labeled destinations with gold active indication and a raised Ask orb, including enlarged variants.
findings: Verify and document every tab's actual target bounds and active-state announcement rather than relying on icon appearance.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: The sheets consistently place branding or a title opposite remaining readings, and reveal screens show the balance changing to zero.
findings: Make the balance's interactive or informational role visually unambiguous.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream primary buttons recur throughout with normal, enlarged, disabled and preparing states, supported by reported browser activation checks.
findings: Include a captured pressed or keyboard-active state to complete the visual interaction evidence.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Secondary actions alternate between gold links and centered cream text on ruled rows throughout the sheets.
findings: Standardize secondary-action treatment so navigation, cancellation and disclosure have predictable visual roles.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Sheets 04–06 show generously spaced answer rows, with supplied evidence reporting Enter/Space advancement and Back retention.
findings: Add a restrained affordance indicating that selecting a row immediately advances.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: The composer shows a serif question, persistent label and prominent focused border, with reported four-line capacity and preserved text.
findings: Make the unfocused input read more clearly as editable without requiring the focus rectangle.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Enlarged question and custom-answer fields reflow, and supplied measurements report exact doubling across seven fields.
findings: Remove long instructional placeholders from single-line fields where enlargement truncates them.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheets 25–26 show distinct on/off positions and colors, supported by reported keyboard, persistence and real motion-stopping checks.
findings: Maintain the full labeled row as the accessible activation area when text enlarges.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheets 12–13 show both populated and unavailable omen states with a free label and explanatory fallback.
findings: Increase separation from navigation so longer omens retain a calm reading area.

components.name: Sky stars and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 28 shows labeled stars, a checked Love selection and corresponding sample question.
findings: Make each star-label pair visibly selectable and document its keyboard focus and target bounds.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 07 shows offline recovery, sharing boundaries and disabled controls, while supplied evidence distinguishes local adapter checks from production authentication.
findings: Attach each disabled control's reason directly to that control.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheets 11–12 show original questions, forecast summaries, date rails and persisted outcome markers.
findings: Add a subtle open-reading affordance and keep status placement consistent.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheets 18–19 show annual selection through a check and gold separator, transparent billing intervals and explicitly simulated continuation.
findings: Preserve a compact price-and-period grouping in the enlarged stacked layout.

components.name: Share preview and exported card
components.evidence: Sheets 26–28 show thumbnail and enlarged compositions, supported by reported real PNG generation and a scalable exact-text transcript.
findings: Increase qualification text in the raster artwork so its meaning survives thumbnail-sized viewing.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: The sheets show voice, export and outcome notices, with supplied evidence reporting retry, persistence and preserved credits.
findings: Place notices nearer their triggering controls and avoid duplicating durable inline status.

components.name: Typography and spacing system
components.evidence: Display serif and sans-serif support text remain consistent across the sheets, with supplied scaling and rendered-background contrast checks.
findings: Reduce oversized heading and whitespace costs on enlarged forms while preserving the user's selected text size.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: The screenshots show borderless mist with stronger patterns behind readers, while supplied evidence reports stopped animation under both motion preferences.
findings: Lower mist contrast behind dense content and eliminate visible rectangular atmospheric boundaries.

components.name: Birthday input
components.evidence: Sheets 01, 14–16 and 29–30 show optional, correction, valid and invalid date fields, with current runtime evidence reporting validation and persistence.
findings: Keep examples outside inputs and distinguish invalid calendar dates from incorrect formatting.

components.name: Age confirmation
components.evidence: Sheet 14 presents two explicit age choices, and current evidence reports acceptance, decline, reload and request gating.
findings: Retain the clear self-report wording and direct consequence of each choice.

components.name: Age restriction and correction recovery
components.evidence: Sheets 01 and 15–16 show distinct restriction/correction states, with current evidence reporting no ordinary bypass and eligible-only continuation.
findings: Keep recovery separate from the ordinary onboarding continuation path.

components.name: Focus selection
components.evidence: Sheets 16–17 show selected and unselected rows, with supplied evidence reporting single selection via keyboard.
findings: Clarify the no-selection continuation without adding a redundant second primary button.

components.name: Birth-profile surface
components.evidence: Sheets 29–30 show sign, age band, birthday and edit actions, with current evidence reporting safe removal and retained eligibility.
findings: Use consistent capitalization for the Sun-sign name and tighten the relationship between facts and editing actions.

components.name: Birth-details form
components.evidence: Sheet 29 shows optional time/city entry and disabled dependent actions, with supplied evidence reporting live city lookup and chart calculation.
findings: Explain which completed field or selected city enables each dependent action.

components.name: Named-person control
components.evidence: Sheets 02–04 show explicit subject modes and labeled first-name editing, with reported invalid-save prevention, draft cancellation and request identity checks.
findings: Preserve the visible selected checkmark and explicit save boundary at both text sizes.

components.name: Evidence disclosure and reader navigation
components.evidence: Sheets 20–24 show category rows, heading focus and return links, supported by supplied full-content and keyboard-return evidence.
findings: Give the free reasoning view the same explicit return affordance as the category readers.

components.name: Export status
components.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show preparing and failed-export states, with supplied evidence reporting deduplicated encoding, injected failure and real retry.
findings: Use one preparing announcement and a recovery-specific retry label.

components.name: Outcome selector
components.evidence: Sheets 07 and 17–18 show unanswered and all three saved choices, with supplied evidence reporting history persistence.
findings: Strengthen grouping and document each choice's target size and announced selected state.

components.name: Close and back controls
components.evidence: Small close and back glyphs recur across modal flows, with supplied focus-return checks covering several editors and readers.
findings: Use explicit return labels where closing could mean either returning one level or leaving the reading.

limitations: This is a provisional browser assessment of the attached sheets and supplied runtime narrative; no tools, source, previous ratings or external task state were inspected.

Scores use the six requested dimensions; A is the normalized mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces, F is the normalized mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility, and overall is round(0.4A + 0.6F, 1).
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across all screens and components; stronger individual scores do not erase weaker states.
Reported browser checks support interaction scores but were not independently rerun, and screenshots alone do not establish operability.
Transition pairs show consistent composition with some atmospheric variation; supplied timing and motion checks do not establish every intermediate frame or perceived continuity.
Content below the viewport was not classified as inaccessible solely because it requires scrolling; the supplied layout sweep reports reachable content at normal and enlarged text sizes.
The correction input's visibly truncated example and the invalid-date message's lack of calendar-specific guidance remain concrete browser issues.
No demonstrated hard-gate failure was established by this material; this does not certify the absence of failures outside the represented evidence.
Synthetic predictions, repeated stress passages, source labels and three-card fixtures were treated as layout evidence, not production-copy defects or evidence of predictive quality.
Input keyboard occlusion, every control's measured target bounds, browser assistive-technology announcements and all pressed states are not comprehensively demonstrated in the supplied material.

Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, microphone delivery, haptics, real payments and OS sharing remain separate unverified boundaries and did not impose a blanket reduction on provisional browser scores.
Production authentication/social delivery and real offline recovery are not established by the pictured offline states or separate local adapter journeys.
No full/native 9/10 certification or repeated-novice-use 10-level outcome is established.
topFixes: Make birthday recovery precise: show complete persistent examples and explain nonexistent calendar dates.
Quiet mist behind long readers and remove rectangular atmospheric seams around supporting orbs.
Standardize back, close and secondary-action roles, especially the free Why view's return to forecast.
Improve scanability of long evidence and source entries without truncating their content.
Increase the exported image's qualification text so it remains legible at ordinary sharing sizes.
Complete browser evidence for target bounds, selected-state announcements, pressed states and keyboard-obscured forms before treating all accessibility dimensions as 9.
